title: WebSocket connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One WebSocket endpoint's settings (CN2 Task 18, loams_connector_brokers::websocket): frames in, frames out. WebSocket has no acknowledgement and no replay, so both directions are at most once and the source is not resumable.

headers.description: Fixed, non-secret handshake headers. A credential header (Authorization, Cookie, X-Api-Key) is refused here; use `auth`.

auth.description: Credentials by secret name: an API key in a named header (`key`) or a bearer token (`jwt`).

key_header.description: The header the API key goes in.

key.description: The API key. A secret name, resolved through the namespace's secret store (D189); the value is never stored here.

bearer.description: A bearer token (Authorization: Bearer …). A secret name, resolved through the namespace's secret store (D189); the value is never stored here.

tls.description: TLS settings: a CA bundle to trust instead of the webpki roots, and a client certificate for mTLS.

cert_pem.description: PEM client certificate chain for mTLS (not a secret).

key_pem.description: The client's PEM private key, for mTLS. A secret name, resolved through the namespace's secret store (D189); the value is never stored here.

subscribe.description: A text frame sent after the handshake, such as a subscription request.

max_batch.description: Messages per batch at most (the pipeline's budget may be smaller).

poll_wait_ms.description: How long one read waits for the first message before reporting nothing.

frame.description: auto (text for textual data, else binary), text, binary, or structured (the CloudEvent as JSON).

pipeline.description: The SDK's per-instance pipeline overrides (`PipelineConfig::with_overrides`): max_batch_rows, max_batch_bytes, linger_ms, max_in_flight_batches, memory_budget_bytes, checkpoint_interval_ms and retry. The broker-side window (prefetch, credit, Receive Maximum, max_ack_pending, receiver queue) is derived from them unless set.
